ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in linear scratches and focal scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white markings are distributed asymmetrically. The right lobe contains a distinctive circular-linear complex (resembling a 'percent' sign) at mid-height, approximately 65% distance from the center. Fine-line white streaks are concentrated along the inner trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. Notable jaggedness is observed on the distal third of both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a highly unique, high-contrast white mark consisting of a circle bisected by a diagonal line, situated in the upper-medial quadrant.
